point_evidence.R1918: Original WU32Get/SetWindowLong classify WNDPROC_WOW and WNDPROC_HANDLE by value bits. A guest encoded FFFF0004 collides with the native-token branch. Modern USER accepts native entrypoints, not CCPU 16:16 procedures. wow_user_get/set_procedure decodes only owned immutable guest entries and returns explicit provenance; native USER owns native procedure slots/tokens. Direct original setter would install a guest address as a native procedure; removing provenance misclassifies the guest FFFF encoding. Real production typed caller fixture covers guest FFFF query/set roundtrips; fixture selectors are representation controls,not executed invented guest selectors.
